ProRes engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's ProRes rollout covers storefront language. Xcode, system frameworks, and Connect actually separate in-app ProRes capture from product-page copy:

  • Camera ProRes recording & format picker UI — Apple Camera feature that records video in Apple ProRes professional intra-frame codec on supported iPhone models, with format options including ProRes 422, ProRes 422 HQ, and ProRes 422 LT where Apple offers them. Controls in-device capture behavior — not App Store language.
  • AVFoundation & VideoToolbox ProRes pipelines — frameworks some apps use to record or export ProRes before or after capture. Your listing may mention ProRes export or NLE-ready files; building capture and encoder pipelines is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Post-production export & NLE handoff — separate in-app surfaces where recorded footage may export as ProRes master files for Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or other editors. Listing copy explains those buyer benefits; encoder wiring is outside AppLocale scope.
  • Camera permissions & capture entitlements — NSCameraUsageDescription, microphone access, and storage access when recording high-bitrate ProRes video. Entitlements and capture wiring are platform work — distinct from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains ProRes to buyers.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of ProRes support in the binary.

A working ProRes capture or export story and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

US/EU indie teams often merge five Camera string families. This page covers product-page listing copy that markets Apple ProRes — professional intra-frame video codec recording and NLE-ready export — not cinematic depth-of-field, not stereoscopic spatial capture, not handheld stabilization, and not log color profiles:

  • ProRes & professional codec marketing (this page) — paragraphs and frame text explaining "Apple ProRes", "ProRes", "ProRes recording", "ProRes export", "ProRes 422", "ProRes 422 HQ", "ProRes 422 LT", "NLE-ready", "Post-production", 专业视频编码, ProRes 编码, and 专业级视频格式. Select ProRes format → record or export → high-bitrate professional video files for editing.
  • Cinematic Mode listing copy (different) — shallow depth-of-field video with rack focus and focus transitions: Cinematic Mode, Cinematic video, 电影效果, 电影模式, 浅景深, 浅景深视频. Cinematic look storytelling — not ProRes codec format selection. Covered on our Cinematic Mode guide.
  • Spatial Video listing copy (different) — stereoscopic spatial video capture for Apple Vision Pro playback: Spatial Video, 空间视频. Immersive spatial capture — not flat ProRes master files for NLE workflows. Not this page.
  • Action Mode listing copy (different) — extra video stabilization for handheld walking and running footage: Action Mode, 动作模式, 运动防抖, 手持稳定视频. Video stabilization — not professional codec export. Covered on our Action Mode guide.
  • Apple Log listing copy (different surface) — log color profile capture for color grading workflows. Log profile marketing uses different vocabulary from ProRes codec format marketing — mention only as contrast; AppLocale does not maintain a separate Apple Log guide page.
  • HDR Video / Dolby Vision (different hero) — HDR encoding and Dolby Vision display pipeline marketing is a separate encoding and display story from ProRes intra-frame codec capture — not the hero of this page.

ProRes adds professional intra-frame codec capture and NLE-ready export. Cinematic Mode adds shallow-depth cinematic look and rack focus to video. Spatial Video adds stereoscopic capture for spatial playback. Action Mode stabilizes handheld walking-running video. Apple Log captures flat log color profiles for grading. Mixing vocabulary across those surfaces on one product page reads like confused localization — scope each screenshot frame to the workflow it actually shows.

Professional codec listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's ProRes feature — not a literal paste of US marketing:

ProRes phrasing

US pages use "Apple ProRes", "ProRes", "ProRes recording", "ProRes export", "ProRes 422", "ProRes 422 HQ", "ProRes 422 LT", "NLE-ready", or "Post-production workflow." Apple's Simplified Chinese Camera vocabulary often uses Apple ProRes and ProRes as branded labels, 专业视频编码 for professional video encoding positioning, ProRes 编码 for ProRes-specific encoding marketing, and 专业级视频格式 for professional-grade video format positioning. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing ProRes variants the iPhone Camera does not offer.

ProRes 422 vs ProRes 422 HQ vs ProRes 422 LT

Screenshot overlays differ by format tier — standard ProRes 422, higher-quality ProRes 422 HQ, or lighter ProRes 422 LT where Apple offers them on iPhone Camera. Chinese buyers expect concise format labels on gallery frames that match Apple's public codec names — not invented ProRes 4444 or other variants iPhone Camera does not ship. Mixing English "ProRes 422 HQ" with Chinese body copy on the same frame looks inconsistent.

ProRes vs Cinematic Mode or Action Mode

When your English listing markets both ProRes codec export and Cinematic Mode or Action Mode, zh-Hans overlays must separate 专业视频编码 / ProRes 编码 vocabulary from 电影模式 / 浅景深 cinematic vocabulary or 动作模式 / 运动防抖 stabilization vocabulary — distinct buyer promises with different screenshot frames on the same product page.
